decision.reasoning_trace: The shopping session presented a mix of items, several of which were not actually backpacks (e.g., towels, drill bits, and chairs). From the relevant products, I focused on tactical and multi-purpose backpacks that showed high durability and capacity. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out as the superior choice due to its high volume, Molle system compatibility, and consistently positive reviews describing it as brilliantly designed and well-made for the price point. While the HIKPRO packable backpack was a strong value option, the QT&QY provides significantly more utility for hiking and general travel.
